## In-Class Agenda

- How do we ethically and legally  work with culture as data?
- Who has the right to represent and circulate culture?
- Legality of data collection
- how to protect people
- gray area
- how to connect with other data maybe?
- Debate: what data should we not collect vs. how can we protect privacy; who should own data; also what is an archive exactly and who should be users?
